summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated June 30, 2026, announcing a routine operational update on its M47 oil exploration block in southeastern Türkiye. The release describes a field scouting and geophysical program to evaluate exploration leads and plan seismic surveys. No terms such as price, stake, premium, or expiry are stated. There is no board recommendation or advisor named. This is a normal operational progress report, not a special situation transaction. No equivalent US special-situation category applies.
